participants.title: Abitabiriye
participants.intro: Abitabiriye bagaragazwa gusa n'imeyili cyangwa nimero bihishe igice.

sessions.title: Ibikorwa
sessions.deleteConfirm: Urashaka gusiba iki gikorwa n'ibisubizo by'imirimo yacyo?

live.title: Igikorwa kiri kuba
live.body: Gikurikira intambwe uwitabiriye agezeho, kigahinduka buri masegonda make. Nta bisubizo bigaragazwa.
live.alert: Urwego {{tier}} saa {{time}}. Kurikiza amabwiriza y'umutekano y'igikorwa maze uvugane n'uwitabiriye.
live.now: Ubu ari kuri: {{step}} mu gihe cya {{time}}
live.notYet: Nta kintu kiraboneka. Intambwe zizagaragara hano uwitabiriye amaze kwinjira kuri telefoni ye.

phone.title: Telefoni y'ubushakashatsi
phone.body: Huza telefoni y'ubushakashatsi n'iki gikorwa ukoresheje kode ya QR. Igikorwa kirangiye, telefoni isibwaho byose ubwayo.
phone.show: Erekana kode ya QR yo gutegura
phone.scan: Fungura kamera ya telefoni uyerekeze kuri iyi kode, hanyuma ukande ku murongo ugaragara.
phone.qrAlt: Kode ya QR yo gutegura telefoni y'ubushakashatsi
phone.endAndWipeConfirm: Soza iki gikorwa? Telefoni yahujwe yohereza ibisigaye, hanyuma igasiba byose ikanasohoka mu masegonda hafi 15.

safety.title: Ibibazo by'umutekano
safety.intro: Byandika urwego, icyabiteye n'ibyakozwe gusa, ntibyandika ibisubizo cyangwa amanota.

tiers.2: Urwego rwa 2: agahinda kagaragaye cyangwa kavuzwe
tiers.3: Urwego rwa 3: umugambi cyangwa ubushake, cyangwa ntashobora kwirinda

users.title: Abakoresha
users.search: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, imeyili cyangwa telefoni
users.name: Izina
users.deleteConfirm: Urashaka gusiba iyi konti n'amakuru yayo yose? Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.

content.title: Ibikubiyemo
content.intro: Buri verisiyo ikenera kwemezwa n'abantu babiri batandukanye mbere yo gutangazwa.
content.yourDraft: Ni wowe wanditse iyi nyandiko, bityo undi muntu agomba kuyisuzuma.

deletions.title: Ibisabwa byo gusiba amakuru
deletions.intro: Rangiza buri busabe mu masaha 72. Kurangiza bisiba amakuru y'uwitabiriye n'aho twamubona.
deletions.completeConfirm: Urashaka gusiba ubu amasuzuma, umwirondoro n'uburyo bwo kuvugisha uyu witabiriye? Ntibishobora gusubizwaho.

audit.title: Igitabo cy'ibikorwa
audit.intro: Buri gikorwa cy'abakozi, uko byakurikiranye. Ibyanditswe ntibishobora guhindurwa.

flags.title: Ibiranga porogaramu
flags.intro: Fungura cyangwa ufunge ibice bitari ngombwa muri iyi porogaramu. Buri mpinduka irandikwa.

names.offlineSync: Kubika nta interineti no kohereza nyuma
names.guideGenerative: Umujyanama wa Rinda (AI, bisaba uruhushya rw'akanama k'imyitwarire)
names.careGeolocation: Serivisi ziri hafi hakurikijwe aho uri

research.title: Raporo y'ubushakashatsi
research.privacy: Ibintu byose hano bibarwa ku bitabiriye bose hamwe. Nta mazina, aho twababona, ibisubizo cyangwa nimero ziranga umuntu birimo.
research.tasksBody: Ibikorwa {{sessions}}, {{ended}} byarangiye. Umurongo werekana abarangije buri murimo, bafashijwe cyangwa batafashijwe.
research.othersBody: Abitabiriye {{withCheckup}} bakoze nibura isuzuma rimwe. {{wellness}} basubije ibibazo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ({{wellnessConsent}} barabyemeye).
research.bandsBody: Isuzuma riheruka rya buri witabiriye. Imibare gusa.

collect.title: Gukusanya nta interineti
collect.intro: Iyo telefoni idafite interineti, fungura Ibisubizo kuri telefoni ukande 'Bihe uyobora igikorwa'. Erekeza kamera y'iyi mudasobwa kuri telefoni kugeza ibice byose byakiriwe.
collect.locked: Ibipaki birafunze. Iyi mudasobwa ntishobora kubisoma; seriveri ya Rinda yonyine ni yo ishobora kubifungura.
collect.noCamera: Kamera ntiboneka. Reba niba iyi mushakisha yemerewe kuyikoresha.
collect.received: Igipaki cyakiriwe. Ushobora gusoma telefoni ikurikira.
collect.offline: Nta interineti iraboneka. Ibipaki biguma kuri iyi mudasobwa kandi bishobora koherezwa nyuma.
collect.undelivered: Byasomwe {{date}}: seriveri ntiyashoboye kwakira iki gipaki. Telefoni iracyafite kopi yayo kandi izacyohereza ibonye interineti.
collect.discardConfirm: Kuraho iki gipaki kuri iyi mudasobwa? Telefoni igumana kopi yayo kandi izacyohereza ibonye interineti.
collect.uploadedToast: Byarangiye: ibyakiriwe byoherejwe ({{saved}} bishya). Ubu biragaragara ku kibaho.
